title: Last Moment Before All Ants Fall Out Of A Plank
description: Calculate the last moment an ant falls off a plank of length n, given ants moving left and right.

steps.note: Initialize maxLeft: the furthest ant moving left is at position 4.
Initialize minRight: the closest ant moving right is at position 0.
Calculate max distance: max(4, 4 - 0) = 4. The result is 4.
